faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about the Helloopass franchise model.
faq.cta_desc: Our team of experts is here to support you in your national franchise project.

questions.a: It is the exclusive right to operate Helloopass OS in a territory and to grant regular licenses to Trade Communities.
Yes, with the approval of the Franchisor (right of first refusal).

questions.q: What is the minimum franchise price?
questions.a: 100,000 USD. The price is calculated using the formula Population \\u00f7 200, with a minimum of 100k and a maximum of 1M USD.
No. The only fees are the entry price and the obligation to dedicate 10% of Growth Revenue to local marketing.
You earn 25% on each transaction, plus 70% of activation fees and annual royalties from Trade Communities.

questions.q: Do I need a payment license?
questions.a: No. Helloopass operates on a voucher system. Buyers cannot 'cash out'. No e-money license required.
Yes. The closed-loop voucher model is legal in most countries. Trade Communities need a simple business license.
No. The technology is provided turnkey. You receive training.
Initial training, technical support (based on formula), and recruitment assistance.

questions.q: Can I operate in multiple countries?
questions.a: Each franchise is territorial. You can acquire multiple territories.

questions.q: What happens if I don't sell enough licenses?
questions.a: Performance goals are defined. In case of persistent difficulty, the exclusive license may become non-exclusive.
